name: chladni-portal-dilogarithm-synthesis
title: The Chladni Portal-Frame Synthesis: Codimension-Three Saddle Overdetermination, Green-Dirichlet-Neumann Chamber Equipartition, and Euler Dilogarithm Li_2(2*theta) Horizon Damping for Riemann's Xi-Function
core_theorems: Theorem 1.1: The Three-Scale Chladni Portal-Frame Synthesis (Macro-Scale Codimension-Three Saddle Overdetermination, Meso-Scale 50%-50% Green-Dirichlet-Neumann Chamber Equipartition, and Micro-Scale Euler Dilogarithm Li_2(2*theta) Horizon Damping)

Theorem 2.1: Portal-Frame Topological Dichotomy, Harmonic Curvature Conservation (1/2)*d_d^2[|R|_{Gamma_*}^2]_{d=0} == -(1/2)*d_t^2[Xi^2]_{t=tau_*} == c_1(tau_*), and Codimension-Three Interior Saddle Overdetermination {I = 0, d_d I = 0, d_t I = 0}

Theorem 2.2: Davenport-Heilbronn Case-I Forcing (c_1^{DH}(tau_{false,m}) < 0 on d = 0), Polya-Jensen Derivative Non-Vanishing, and Exact Portal-Frame Reduction to 1D Critical-Line Positivity c_1(t) > 0

Theorem 3.1: Exact 50%-50% Green-Dirichlet-Neumann Chamber Equipartition Identity int_{tau_k(d_0)}^{tau_{k+1}(d_0)} R*d_d R dt == int_{tau_k(d_0)}^{tau_{k+1}(d_0)} I*d_d I dt == iint_{Omega_k(d_0)} |Xi'(t - i*d)|^2 dd dt = (1/2)*W_{Omega_k}(d_0) > 0

Theorem 3.2: Wronskian-Slope Reciprocity tau_k'(d) == (R*d_t R)/(d*W_tilde), Wall-Amplitude Evolution (d/dd)(1/2 R^2) == d*W_tilde*(1 + tau_k'(d)^2), and Euler-Product Wall Rigidity vs. Davenport-Heilbronn Fold Rupture at (d_tip, t_tip)

Theorem 4.1: Forward Cubic-Window Decomposition of (1/2)*P_{>X}(s)^2 = T_{<=N}(s) + C_{>N}(s) and the Attenuated Semiprime Spring Floor min_{U in R} |1 + U + (eta/2)*U^2|^2 = (1 - 1/(2*eta))^2 > 0 for eta > 1/2

Theorem 4.2: Universal Closed-Form Euler Dilogarithm Li_2(2*theta) Stieltjes Laws for M_{sq}^{(p)}(theta), M_{tri}^{(p)}(theta), and eta^{(p)}(theta) (p in {0, 1, 2, 3}), proving eta^{(0)}(1/6) = 0.243955 < 50% vs. eta^{(2)}(1/6) = 0.676891 > 2/3 > 50% and eta^{(3)}(1/6) = 0.798091 (~80%)

Theorem 4.3: Stationary-Phase Saddle Sign Reversal xi_N^*(t) = (1/2)*omega_N(t), Dirichlet Hyperbola Reflection Duality omega_p(t) + omega_q(t) == ln m_dual(pq), and Fourth-Order Apex Pinching (omega_p*omega_q)^2 <= (1/16)*(ln m_dual)^4 -> 0
